newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli helicopter hits south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli helicopter hits south Lebanon.

text.p: An Israeli helicopter fired one rocket on Wednesday into a suspected Hizbollah base in south Lebanon after the guerrillas wounded an Israeli soldier in south Lebanon, Lebanese and pro-Israeli security souces said.
Lebanese security sources said the air raid targeted an area behind Jabal al-Rafii in the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridges, a Hizbollah bastion.

The strike followed a Hizbollah attack with mortar bombs aginst a joint Israeli-South Lebanon Army (SLA) outpost in Beir Kallab inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. One Israeli soldier was wounded in the attack, pro-Israeli SLA sources said.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said a missile launcher was destroyed in the outpost.
